title: 2018 AMC 12B Problem 6
statement: Suppose \(S\) cans of soda can be purchased from a vending machine for \(Q\) quarters. Which of the following expressions describes the number of cans of soda that can be purchased for \(D\) dollars, where \(1\) dollar is worth \(4\) quarters?

solutions.text:
One can costs \(\tfrac{Q}{S}\) quarters, which is \(\tfrac{Q}{4S}\) dollars. The number of cans that \(D\) dollars can buy is

\[ \dfrac{D}{\tfrac{Q}{4S}}=\dfrac{4DS}{Q}. \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Convert \(D\) dollars to \(4D\) quarters, then divide by the price per can
